name: @resus/module_09_corridor_coordination
description: Module 9 — traffic-corridor coordination. Derives a corridor geofence from a persisted planned route, detects (simulated) road users inside it through a deterministic provider, records the corridor and its notification intents through module 11, and emits CORRIDOR_ACTIVATED / CORRIDOR_RELEASED / NOTIFICATION_SENT. Entirely simulated: no traffic-signal, road-user feed or real notification integration exists, and every corridor is stored with priorityMode SIMULATED.
